notes: Inaccessible: the UAB 'Generative AI and UAB Policy' page (uab.edu/ai/guidelines-principles/generative-ai-and-uab-policy, also dpo.uab.edu mirror and /practical-recommendations, /responsible-ai/practical-guidance) appears in search results (students should not use generative AI unless the course syllabus approves it, and must disclose) but returns 404 on fetch, so it was not collected.
